scope: Independent source-only review of prepared BLS vendored hooks; no build or executable tests run by this reviewer.
checked_invariants: Only new feature hooks, G1 constructor and manifests differ from published arithmetic. Upstream scalar/field/curve/hash-to-curve/pairing arithmetic is unchanged.
G1 is exactly x then y, each six explicit LE u64 Montgomery limbs. G2 is 68 coefficient triples, each tuple0/1/2 then Fp2 c0/c1 then six LE limbs.
Every output byte is initialized for successful exact-size writes; identity rejection precedes any write. No struct bytes, padding, uninitialized memory or host endianness dependence.
Canonical point decoding and existing reduced field arithmetic produce each stored Montgomery value in [0,p). Readers intentionally trust only immutable factory-produced same-version payloads.
Writer and reader invoke the same upstream Miller driver. Independent BLS_X traversal gives 63 doubling and 5 addition steps, including the final doubling: total 68.
Owned/borrowed terms use the original ell, square, conjugate, Fp12 identity and identity masking. Direct-path arithmetic is unchanged.

No unsafe code, pointer casts, mutable static state, retained references or allocation occurs in the new hooks. Borrowed slices are lifetime-bound to the synchronous call; one coefficient is decoded into stack values.

The generator utility encodes G2Affine::generator through the exact approved writer into a fully initialized 19,584-byte buffer. Runtime include_bytes supplies one immutable static in an 8-byte-aligned wrapper, with no native pointers or mutable cache.

Both direct and prepared-key IC verification borrow the same immutable generator table. Ordinary dynamic pairing paths substitute the constant only when the validated G2 point equals the canonical generator; all other points retain Owned preparation.
The shared generator changes storage/preparation only: sign convention, operand order, ell, Miller driver and final exponentiation remain unchanged. Owned identity handling stays intact.
Runtime test source compares the complete generator fixture against freshly written generator coefficients, checks alignment, and compares final exponentiation against upstream ordinary preparation.
limits: This is a source review, not an external cryptographic audit or a claim of executed tests.
Trusted payload unforgeability, GC/lifetime bridge behavior, public error semantics, module/compiler integration and benchmark evidence are reviewed elsewhere.
Any arithmetic or payload-layout source change invalidates this source fingerprint and needs review.
